source.source: OpenStreetMap contributors + IGN MDE-Ar v2.1 30 m / original public snapshots
source.version: way versions retained in row lineage
source.scope: sac_scale publicado en tramos argentinos, con geometría OSM y relieve IGN de 30 m. Test por regiones completas; faltan regiones, observaciones y validación de rutas completas y seguridad.
source.label_definition: Native sac_scale tag, excluding untagged ways; never calculate labels from geometry or include sac_scale/technical_score among features.
source.transformations: Haversine distance and path/chord ratio from complete node geometry. Nearest original IGN cells sampled at uniform chainage <=60 m; median3 elevation profile, ascent/descent and absolute grades are derived predictors, never targets. Missing geometry/elevation rejected, no imputation. Group complete regions and connected networks, equal names and shared relations together.
source.ign_license: Public free official download; no separate per-tile open license asserted.

geographic_holdout.reason: Prespecified before fitting the Argentine expansion; reserve two complete regions. All connected ways, same names and relations remain together.

excluded_records.reason: IGN coverage missing/nodata; never fabricate or impute elevation
